summary.en: Compare wood tones and decorative finishes before you specify the panel.
summary.zh: 从木纹色调与饰面效果开始确认材料。

description.en:
Explore a woodgrain-faced MDF option for coordinated furniture and interior surfaces. Use the finish images to start a colour discussion, then confirm the current decor code, texture and base-board specification.
A reviewed sample helps you match the panel with the other materials in your design.
description.zh:
用于协调家具与室内表面效果的木纹饰面密度板选项。可用配图发起花色沟通，再确认当前花色编号、表面质感及基材规格。
通过小样核对，便于与设计中的其他材料搭配。

en: Woodgrain finish reference and a range of colour samples.
Compare tone and texture with your furniture design.
Panel thickness and specification confirmed for the selected decor.
zh: 配有木纹效果参考及多款花色小样。
可围绕家具设计核对色调与质感。
所选花色对应的厚度与板材配置另行确认。

applications.en: Furniture fronts, cabinet components and interior decorative parts where the board grade is appropriate.
applications.zh: 适用于对应板材等级允许的家具表面、柜体部件及室内装饰部件。

value.en: Woodgrain decorative surface; sample colours shown
value.zh: 木纹装饰表面，附花色小样展示

value.en: Confirm by specification and order mix
value.zh: 按规格及订单组合确认

value.en: Request current sample terms and production schedule
value.zh: 询价时确认样品条件及当前排产
